project_name: STMAC Interactive Saudi Infrastructure & Data Reconstruction Console
app_type: single-page interactive scientific dashboard & data visualization experience
archetype: LUXURY & PERFORMANCE PRO HYBRID (Futuristic Deep Obsidian #0A0A0A with Neon Gold #D4AF37 & Emerald #00F5D4 data glows)
key_functionalities: Live STMAC reconstruction console with real-time tensor iteration controls
Interactive Saudi station network map (Riyadh Metro, Mecca Metro, Land Bridge nodes)
Outage & block-length slider controls with dynamic matrix sparsity simulation
Live reconstruction chart (Normalized Root Mean Squared Error & Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio curves)
Bento grid of metrics/cards (tensor rank, recovery rate, latency, topological persistence)
Block-length sweep sensitivity matrix with interactive heatmaps
Vision 2030 cost model calculator & ROI simulator
Data provenance, mathematical formulation citations & exportable reconstruction reports
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the dashboard is exceptionally polished, responsive, and fully interactive. Include smooth transitions, rich charts with Recharts, interactive SVG/Canvas network map of Saudi transport hubs, customizable tensor rank sliders, Vision 2030 cost model interactive sliders, sound/visual feedback on reconstruction runs, and complete test attributes (data-testid).
universal_guidelines: No pure black #000000 or generic gray; use tinted deep obsidian #07090E
Never use complete transparent background on headers/overlays
All interactive elements must include data-testid
Use generous spacing p-6 to p-12
Keep hero headings under text-6xl with tight tracking
